name: Gold Medal Products Co. - Indianapolis
old_description: At Gold Medal – Indianapolis, you’ll find customer service is the number one priority. Since 1993, we have served as the region’s concession equipment and supplies provider. Our customers range from Indianapolis to Fort Wayne, Evansville, Louisville, Terre Haute, Bloomington, South Bend, Mishawaka, and Elkhart. Our local reps know and understand your market. We keep our showroom and warehouse fully stocked with all the popcorn, cotton candy, Sno-Kone®, hot dog, fryer, and other concession equipment you need. We’ll provide an in-house demo so you can see and taste the products in action. When you buy from Gold Medal – Indianapolis, you get more than just a product. You get personalized service, local support, savings on shipping, and many other benefits.
about:
Gold Medal Products Co. – Indianapolis operates from Noblesville, Indiana, where it has served as the region’s concession equipment and supplies provider since 1993. The branch is managed by Michael Knotts and functions as a local sales and support outpost for the broader Gold Medal Products Co. network.

The facility maintains a showroom and warehouse stocked with concession equipment including popcorn machines, cotton candy makers, Sno-Kone® units, hot dog rollers, fryers, and related supplies. The team offers in-house equipment demonstrations so customers can evaluate performance before purchase, and provides consultation for new concession ventures or menu expansions.

The branch serves operators across central Indiana and neighboring cities such as Fort Wayne, Evansville, Louisville, Terre Haute, Bloomington, South Bend, Mishawaka, and Elkhart. Its customer base includes independent concession stands, stadium vendors, school and church groups, and entrepreneurs entering the concession food business.

The company emphasizes personalized service, local support, and reduced shipping costs as its primary differentiators, positioning itself as a hands-on partner rather than a distant supplier.
